documentation.file_docstring:
Job Receipt Schemas

Defines receipts for job completion and outcome verification.
member_docstrings: JobReceipt: Base receipt for a job/task between agents.
JobCompletionReceipt: Receipt issued when a job is completed.
SignedReceipt: A receipt with cryptographic signatures from both parties.
DisputeReceipt: Receipt for a disputed job outcome.
compute_hash: Compute deterministic hash of receipt.
is_fully_signed: Check if both parties have signed.
is_nexus_witnessed: Check if Nexus has witnessed this receipt.
